description: This Java source file defines the 'Expressions' class, providing static helper methods to create various logical expression transforms used within Apache Spark's SQL connector framework. It includes methods for creating transforms like apply, column references, literals, bucketing, date/time transformations, and sorting.

classes.name: Expressions
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to create logical expression transforms for Spark SQL.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Creates a logical transform for applying a named transform with given arguments.

methods.name: column
methods.description: Creates a named reference expression for a (nested) column.

methods.name: literal
methods.description: Creates a literal expression from a given value.

methods.name: bucket
methods.description: Creates a bucket transform for one or more columns, mapping values to bucket IDs.

methods.name: identity
methods.description: Creates an identity transform for a specified column.

methods.name: years
methods.description: Creates a yearly transform for a timestamp or date column.

methods.name: months
methods.description: Creates a monthly transform for a timestamp or date column.

methods.name: days
methods.description: Creates a daily transform for a timestamp or date column.

methods.name: hours
methods.description: Creates an hourly transform for a timestamp column.

methods.name: sort
methods.description: Creates a sort expression with specified direction and null ordering.
